title: Plan
description: Output of the worker's plan phase. Becomes the contract that tests_red and implement work against. Static plan-checker (scripts/plan-static-check.js) gates on size metrics derived from this.

what_to_do.description: One coherent intent. Prefix with [no-test] when this file's change is structurally untestable (pure plumbing, doc comment, type alias). The [no-test] marker is honoured by tests_red — it does not require a corresponding test.

test_strategy.description: Which test files will be touched, what real-vs-mock strategy, any test infrastructure deltas

revision.description: Set by the worker if it revises the plan mid-session (e.g. tests_red surfaced an infeasibility). Records the original plan and the why.

static_check_verdict.description: Set by orchestrator after plan-static-check runs. Worker should not write this field.
